lessons.title: Goodbye and hello
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, six years are over. It's time to say goodbye.
Ben: Goodbye to primary, hello to junior!
Anna: Let's set a goal: read 20 English books this summer.
Ben: I believe we can do it.
Anna: Thank you, friends and teachers. The future is bright!
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，六年结束了，要说再见了。
本：再见小学，你好初中！
安娜：定个目标：暑假读 20 本英文书。
本：我相信我们能做到。
安娜：谢谢朋友和老师，未来一片光明！

lessons.title: A bright future
lessons.en: Today we say goodbye to primary school. Six years gave us knowledge, courage and good friends. Believe in yourself — set goals, work hard, and treat people with kindness. Thank our parents, teachers and classmates for the love and support. A new chapter begins in junior high. The future is bright when we walk towards it with a smile.
lessons.cn: 今天我们告别小学。六年给了我们知识、勇气和好朋友。相信自己——立目标，努力，善待他人。感谢父母、老师和同学的关爱与支持。新的篇章在初中开启。带着微笑走向未来，未来必定光明！
